judul.en: Criteria for Unrestricted Return to Competition
judul.zh: 无限制重返比赛的标准

teks.id: Tanpa nyeri/bengkak, ROM penuh, lutut stabil
teks.en: No pain/swelling, full ROM, stable knee
teks.zh: 无疼痛/肿胀，关节活动度（ROM）完全，膝关节稳定
teks.uz: Ogʻriq/shish yoʻq, ROM toʻliq, tizza barqaror

teks.id: Quadriceps & hamstring 60°/s simetri ≥ 90%; 100% untuk olahraga pivot
teks.en: Quadriceps & hamstring at 60°/s: symmetry ≥ 90%; 100% for pivoting sports
teks.zh: 股四头肌与腘绳肌 60°/s 对称性 ≥ 90%；变向/旋转类运动需达 100%
teks.uz: Kvadritseps va hamstring 60°/s da: simmetriya ≥ 90%; burilishli (pivot) sport turlari uchun 100%

teks.id: CMJ & drop jump > 90% simetri (tinggi & impuls)
teks.en: CMJ & drop jump > 90% symmetry (height & impulse)
teks.zh: CMJ 与跳深（drop jump）对称性 > 90%（高度与冲量）
teks.uz: CMJ va drop jump > 90% simmetriya (balandlik va impuls)

teks.id: RSI > 1,3 (dua kaki), > 0,5 (satu kaki) pada atlet lapangan
teks.en: RSI > 1.3 (double-leg), > 0.5 (single-leg) in field-sport athletes
teks.zh: 场地项目运动员：RSI > 1.3（双腿）、> 0.5（单腿）
teks.uz: Maydon sportchilarida RSI > 1,3 (ikki oyoq), > 0,5 (bir oyoq)

teks.id: Pola lompat & lari > 90% simetri
teks.en: Jumping & running patterns > 90% symmetry
teks.zh: 跳跃与跑步模式对称性 > 90%
teks.uz: Sakrash va yugurish shakli > 90% simmetriya

teks.id: Kesiapan mental (ACL-RSI) & kinesiofobia (TSK) normal
teks.en: Normal psychological readiness (ACL-RSI) & kinesiophobia (TSK)
teks.zh: 心理准备度（ACL-RSI）与运动恐惧（TSK）正常
teks.uz: Ruhiy tayyorgarlik (ACL-RSI) va kineziofobiya (TSK) meʼyorda

teks.id: Program spesifik olahraga selesai tanpa reaksi lutut
teks.en: Sport-specific programme completed without knee reaction
teks.zh: 完成专项运动训练计划，膝关节无不良反应
teks.uz: Sportga xos dastur tizza reaksiyasisiz yakunlangan

teks.id: Tidak lebih awal dari 9 bulan pasca-operasi
teks.en: No earlier than 9 months after surgery
teks.zh: 术后不早于 9 个月
teks.uz: Operatsiyadan keyin 9 oydan erta emas

teks.id: **Semua kriteria harus terpenuhi bersamaan.**
teks.en: **All criteria must be met simultaneously.**
teks.zh: **所有标准必须同时满足。**
teks.uz: **Barcha mezonlar bir vaqtda bajarilishi shart.**

teks.id: Referensi: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [4] Kyritsis 2016 · [10] Webster 2008 · [17] Ardern 2016
teks.en: References: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [4] Kyritsis 2016 · [10] Webster 2008 · [17] Ardern 2016
teks.zh: 参考文献：[1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [4] Kyritsis 2016 · [10] Webster 2008 · [17] Ardern 2016
teks.uz: Manbalar: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [4] Kyritsis 2016 · [10] Webster 2008 · [17] Ardern 2016

pesan.en: Able to run ≠ ready to compete

baris.zh: 等速对称性 ≥ 90%（变向/旋转类运动需达 100%）

baris.id: Pogo satu kaki tanpa nyeri; impuls eksentrik CMJ LSI > 80%
baris.en: Pain-free single-leg pogo; CMJ eccentric impulse LSI > 80%
baris.zh: 单腿弹跳（pogo）无痛；CMJ 离心冲量 LSI > 80%
baris.uz: Bir oyoqda pogo sakrash ogʻriqsiz; CMJ ekssentrik impulsi LSI > 80%

baris.id: CMJ & drop jump > 90% simetri; RSI sesuai target
baris.en: CMJ & drop jump > 90% symmetry; RSI on target
baris.zh: CMJ 与跳深对称性 > 90%；RSI 达标
baris.uz: CMJ va drop jump > 90% simmetriya; RSI maqsadga mos

baris.en: Flexion ≥ 95% of the healthy side, full extension
baris.zh: 屈曲 ≥ 健侧的 95%，伸直完全
baris.uz: Bukilish sogʻlom tomonning ≥ 95% i, toʻliq yozilish

baris.id: Tetap tenang setelah latihan intensitas tinggi
baris.zh: 高强度训练后仍保持平稳
baris.uz: Yuqori intensivlikdagi mashgʻulotdan keyin ham tinch

baris.zh: 完成专项运动训练计划

teks.id: Sudah bisa berlari bukan berarti sudah siap kembali bermain atau bertanding.
teks.en: Being able to run does not mean being ready to return to play or competition.
teks.zh: 能够跑步并不意味着已准备好重返运动或比赛。
teks.uz: Yugura olish oʻyinga yoki musobaqaga qaytishga tayyor ekanini anglatmaydi.

teks.id: Referensi: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [7] Rambaud 2018 · [10] Webster 2008
teks.en: References: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [7] Rambaud 2018 · [10] Webster 2008
teks.zh: 参考文献：[1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [7] Rambaud 2018 · [10] Webster 2008
teks.uz: Manbalar: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [7] Rambaud 2018 · [10] Webster 2008

judul.zh: 危险信号：何时需要重新评估
judul.uz: Xavfli belgilar: qachon qayta baholash kerak

teks.id: Curiga arthrofibrosis / lesi cyclops; evaluasi bila ROM berhenti membaik
teks.en: Suspect arthrofibrosis / cyclops lesion; evaluate if ROM stops improving
teks.zh: 怀疑关节纤维化/独眼征（cyclops）病变；ROM 停止改善时应评估
teks.uz: Artrofibroz / cyclops shikastlanishiga gumon; ROM yaxshilanishdan toʻxtasa baholang

teks.id: Turunkan beban; evaluasi bila efusi menetap
teks.en: Reduce load; evaluate if effusion persists
teks.zh: 降低负荷；积液持续时应评估
teks.uz: Yuklamani kamaytiring; effuziya saqlanib qolsa baholang

teks.id: Curiga infeksi; rujuk segera ke operator
teks.en: Suspect infection; refer urgently to the operating surgeon
teks.zh: 怀疑感染；立即转诊至主刀医生
teks.uz: Infeksiyaga gumon; zudlik bilan operatsiya qilgan shifokorga yoʻllang

judul.zh: 小腿疼痛/肿胀、呼吸困难

teks.id: Curiga DVT / emboli paru; tindakan darurat
teks.en: Suspect DVT / pulmonary embolism; emergency management
teks.zh: 怀疑 DVT/肺栓塞；紧急处理
teks.uz: DVT / oʻpka emboliyasiga gumon; shoshilinch choralar

teks.id: Curiga kegagalan repair / robekan meniskus baru
teks.en: Suspect repair failure / new meniscal tear
teks.zh: 怀疑修复失败/新的半月板撕裂
teks.uz: Tikish muvaffaqiyatsizligi / yangi menisk yirtigʻiga gumon

teks.id: Evaluasi stabilitas graft
teks.en: Evaluate graft stability
teks.zh: 评估移植物稳定性
teks.uz: Graft barqarorligini baholang

teks.id: Ringkasan praktik klinis; selalu koordinasikan dengan dokter operator. Referensi: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022
teks.en: Summary of clinical practice; always coordinate with the operating surgeon. References: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022
teks.zh: 临床实践摘要；请始终与主刀医生协调。参考文献：[1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022
teks.uz: Klinik amaliyot xulosasi; har doim operatsiya qilgan shifokor bilan kelishing. Manbalar: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022

judul.zh: 以 METs 衡量的工作体力需求

baris.zh: 电脑工作 1.3 · 轻度坐姿任务 1.5
baris.uz: Kompyuterda ishlash 1,3 · yengil oʻtirib bajariladigan vazifalar 1,5

baris.zh: 2–4 周，逐步增加 + 交通协助

baris.en: Light standing 1.8 · walking in the office 3.8
baris.zh: 轻度站立 1.8 · 办公室内步行 3.8
护理患者 2.3–3.5 · 建筑施工 4.0

baris.id: Kerja manual berat 6,5 · angkut beban berat 7,3–8,0
baris.en: Heavy manual labour 6.5 · carrying heavy loads 7.3–8.0
baris.zh: 重体力劳动 6.5 · 搬运重物 7.3–8.0
baris.uz: Ogʻir qoʻl mehnati 6,5 · ogʻir yuk tashish 7,3–8,0

baris.id: 10–16 mgg; bisa lebih lama bila ada proteksi
baris.en: 10–16 wk; may be longer if protection is required
baris.uz: 10–16 hafta; himoya talab qilinsa uzoqroq boʻlishi mumkin

teks.id: Kapasitas fungsional pasien harus setara atau melebihi tuntutan METs pekerjaannya, tanpa nyeri atau bengkak bertambah
teks.en: The patient’s functional capacity must equal or exceed the METs demand of the job, without increased pain or swelling
teks.zh: 患者的功能能力须达到或超过其工作的 METs 需求，且疼痛或肿胀不加重
teks.uz: Bemorning funksional imkoniyati ishning METs talabiga teng yoki undan yuqori boʻlishi, ogʻriq yoki shish kuchaymasligi kerak

teks.id: Pegawai kantor yang sudah berjalan nyaman dengan kecepatan sedang (± 3,8 METs) umumnya siap untuk tugas kantor
teks.en: An office worker who already walks comfortably at moderate speed (± 3.8 METs) is generally ready for office duties
teks.zh: 能以中等速度舒适步行（约 3.8 METs）的办公室职员，通常已可胜任办公室工作
teks.uz: Oʻrtacha tezlikda qulay yura oladigan (± 3,8 METs) ofis xodimi odatda ofis vazifalariga tayyor

teks.id: Mulai dengan jam kerja dikurangi atau kerja dari rumah, selingi duduk dan berdiri, hindari jongkok dan berlutut berulang
teks.en: Start with reduced hours or working from home, alternate sitting and standing, avoid repeated squatting and kneeling
teks.zh: 从缩短工时或居家办公开始，坐站交替，避免反复下蹲和跪姿
teks.uz: Qisqartirilgan ish soatlari yoki uydan ishlashdan boshlang, oʻtirish va turishni almashtiring, takroriy choʻkkalash va tiz choʻkishdan saqlaning

teks.id: Pengelompokan METs ke kategori kerja adalah contoh; waktu kerja = opini ahli. Referensi: [32] ACC/NZOA · [33] Herrmann dkk., J Sport Health Sci 2024
teks.en: Grouping of METs into work categories is illustrative; return-to-work timing = expert opinion. References: [32] ACC/NZOA · [33] Herrmann et al., J Sport Health Sci 2024
teks.zh: METs 与工作类别的对应仅为示例；复工时间 = 专家意见。参考文献：[32] ACC/NZOA · [33] Herrmann 等，J Sport Health Sci 2024
teks.uz: METs ni ish toifalariga ajratish misol tariqasida; ishga qaytish muddati = ekspert fikri. Manbalar: [32] ACC/NZOA · [33] Herrmann va boshq., J Sport Health Sci 2024

judul.en: Functional Criteria for Return to Office Work
judul.zh: 重返办公室工作的功能标准

pesan.id: Jalan normal, duduk nyaman, siap kerja
pesan.en: Normal gait, comfortable sitting, ready for work
pesan.zh: 步态正常、坐姿舒适、即可上班
pesan.uz: Normal yurish, qulay oʻtirish — ishga tayyor

teks.id: Tanpa kruk dan tanpa pincang
teks.en: Without crutches and without limping
teks.zh: 不用拐杖、无跛行
teks.uz: Qoʻltiqtayoqsiz va oqsoqlanmasdan

teks.id: Ekstensi penuh; fleksi ± 90–110° untuk duduk, bangkit dari kursi, dan tangga
teks.en: Full extension; flexion ± 90–110° for sitting, rising from a chair, and stairs
teks.zh: 伸直完全；屈曲约 90–110°，以满足坐下、从椅子站起和上下楼梯
teks.uz: Toʻliq yozilish; oʻtirish, stuldan turish va zinapoya uchun bukilish ± 90–110°

teks.id: 0 atau trace pada stroke test, juga di akhir hari kerja
teks.en: 0 or trace on the stroke test, also at the end of the working day
teks.zh: stroke test 为 0 或微量（trace），工作日结束时亦然
teks.uz: Stroke testda 0 yoki iz (trace), ish kuni oxirida ham

teks.id: Selesai tanpa nyeri atau pincang; jarak naik di tiap evaluasi
teks.en: Completed without pain or limping; distance increases at each assessment
teks.zh: 完成测试无疼痛或跛行；每次评估距离均有增加
teks.uz: Ogʻriq yoki oqsoqlanishsiz bajariladi; har bir baholashda masofa ortadi

teks.id: KOOS-ADL atau IKDC membaik bermakna dari evaluasi sebelumnya
teks.en: KOOS-ADL or IKDC improves meaningfully from the previous assessment
teks.zh: KOOS-ADL 或 IKDC 较上次评估有显著改善
teks.uz: KOOS-ADL yoki IKDC oldingi baholashga nisbatan sezilarli yaxshilangan

teks.id: Kaki kanan ± 4–6 mgg, kiri ± 2–3 mgg, bila mampu mengerem darurat
teks.en: Right leg ± 4–6 wk, left ± 2–3 wk, provided the patient can perform an emergency stop
teks.zh: 右腿约 4–6 周，左腿约 2–3 周，前提是能够紧急制动
teks.uz: Oʻng oyoq ± 4–6 hafta, chap ± 2–3 hafta, agar favqulodda tormoz bera olsa

butir.id: Protokol ATS: lintasan datar 30 m, instruksi dan dorongan standar, catat jarak, nyeri, dan pola jalan.
butir.en: ATS protocol: flat 30 m course, standardised instructions and encouragement; record distance, pain, and gait pattern.
butir.zh: ATS 方案：30 m 平直走道，标准化指令与鼓励语；记录距离、疼痛和步态。
butir.uz: ATS protokoli: 30 m tekis yoʻlak, standart koʻrsatma va ragʻbatlantirish; masofa, ogʻriq va yurish shaklini qayd eting.

teks.id:
TB (tinggi badan) dalam cm, BB (berat badan) dalam kg, usia dalam tahun.
**Cara pakai:** hitung % prediksi dan pantau trennya. 6MWT bukan tes khusus lutut; pakai bersama kriteria lain.
teks.en:
Height in cm, weight in kg, age in years.
**How to use:** calculate the % predicted and monitor the trend. The 6MWT is not a knee-specific test; use it together with the other criteria.
teks.zh:
身高单位 cm，体重单位 kg，年龄单位岁。
**使用方法：**计算预测值百分比并观察趋势。6MWT 并非膝关节专项测试，应与其他标准结合使用。
teks.uz:
Boʻy — sm, vazn — kg, yosh — yil.
**Qoʻllash:** bashoratning % ini hisoblang va dinamikasini kuzating. 6MWT tizzaga xos test emas; boshqa mezonlar bilan birga qoʻllang.

teks.id: Ambang kembali bekerja berbasis 6MWT belum baku untuk ACL; gunakan sebagai tren. Referensi: [1] [25] [26] [27] [34] Enright 1998 · [35] ATS 2002 · [36] Rowe 2000
teks.en: No established 6MWT-based return-to-work threshold exists for ACL; use it as a trend. References: [1] [25] [26] [27] [34] Enright 1998 · [35] ATS 2002 · [36] Rowe 2000
teks.zh: ACL 术后尚无基于 6MWT 的标准复工阈值，应作为趋势参考。参考文献：[1] [25] [26] [27] [34] Enright 1998 · [35] ATS 2002 · [36] Rowe 2000
teks.uz: ACL uchun 6MWT ga asoslangan ishga qaytish chegarasi hali belgilanmagan; dinamika sifatida foydalaning. Manbalar: [1] [25] [26] [27] [34] Enright 1998 · [35] ATS 2002 · [36] Rowe 2000

kicker.zh: 项目评估 · 核查人员

judul.id: Alur Verifikasi Program yang Melewati Timeline
judul.en: Verification Pathway for Programmes Exceeding the Timeline
judul.zh: 超出预期时间线项目的核查流程
judul.uz: Belgilangan muddatdan oshgan dasturni tekshirish tartibi

teks.id: Laporan operasi: jenis graft, tindakan meniskus/kartilago, augmentasi. Tentukan timeline yang wajar
teks.en: Operative report: graft type, meniscal/cartilage procedure, augmentation. Determine a reasonable timeline
teks.zh: 手术记录：移植物类型、半月板/软骨处理、加强术。确定合理的时间线
teks.uz: Operatsiya bayonnomasi: graft turi, menisk/togʻay muolajasi, augmentatsiya. Oqilona muddatni belgilang

teks.id: Bandingkan fase yang dicapai dengan perkiraan waktu; gerbang mana yang belum lulus?
teks.en: Compare the phase reached with the expected time; which gates have not been passed?
teks.zh: 将已达到的阶段与预期时间对比；哪些关卡尚未通过？
teks.uz: Erishilgan bosqichni kutilgan muddat bilan solishtiring; qaysi darvozalardan hali oʻtilmagan?

teks.id: Data terukur dan bertanggal di tiap evaluasi: ROM, efusi, kekuatan, lompatan, PROM
teks.en: Measured, dated data at each assessment: ROM, effusion, strength, jumping, PROMs
teks.zh: 每次评估均有可测量且注明日期的数据：ROM、积液、肌力、跳跃、PROM
teks.uz: Har bir baholashda oʻlchangan va sanasi koʻrsatilgan maʼlumotlar: ROM, effuziya, kuch, sakrash, PROM

teks.id: Komplikasi atau cedera penyerta yang terdokumentasi, atau tanpa penjelasan?
teks.en: Documented complications or concomitant injuries, or no explanation?
teks.zh: 是否有已记录的并发症或合并损伤，还是无法解释？
teks.uz: Hujjatlashtirilgan asorat yoki yondosh jarohat bormi, yoki izohsizmi?

teks.id: Lanjutkan, revisi target, rujuk/peer review, atau transisi ke program mandiri
teks.en: Continue, revise targets, refer/peer review, or transition to a self-managed programme
teks.zh: 继续、修订目标、转诊/同行评议，或过渡到自主训练计划
teks.uz: Davom ettirish, maqsadlarni qayta koʻrib chiqish, yoʻllash/hamkasblar ekspertizasi yoki mustaqil dasturga oʻtish

judul.zh: 需提供的最低限度文件

butir.en: Therapy plan + targets for each phase
butir.zh: 治疗计划 + 各阶段目标
butir.uz: Davolash rejasi + har bir bosqich maqsadlari

butir.zh: 注明日期的客观评估结果
如有并发症，提供会诊/转诊记录

teks.id: Timeline acuan: tabel tindakan & peta fase pada bagian sebelumnya. Referensi: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022
teks.en: Reference timeline: procedure table & phase map in the previous sections. References: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022
teks.zh: 参考时间线：见前文的手术类型表与阶段图。参考文献：[1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022
teks.uz: Asosiy muddatlar: oldingi boʻlimlardagi muolajalar jadvali va bosqichlar xaritasi. Manbalar: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022

kicker.zh: 项目评估 · 核查人员

judul.id: Alat Ukur Objektif untuk Menilai Progres
judul.zh: 评估进展的客观测量工具
judul.uz: Progressni baholash uchun obyektiv oʻlchov vositalari

baris.id: Ekstensi penuh simetris; fleksi meningkat di tiap evaluasi
baris.en: Full, symmetrical extension; flexion increasing at each assessment
baris.zh: 伸直完全且两侧对称；屈曲每次评估均有增加
baris.uz: Toʻliq simmetrik yozilish; bukilish har bir baholashda ortadi

baris.id: Menurun, atau stabil di 0/trace setelah latihan
baris.en: Decreasing, or stable at 0/trace after exercise
baris.zh: 逐渐减少，或训练后稳定在 0/微量
baris.uz: Kamayib bormoqda yoki mashqdan keyin 0/iz darajasida barqaror

baris.id: LSI meningkat: > 80% untuk mulai lari, ≥ 90% untuk RTS
baris.en: LSI increasing: > 80% to start running, ≥ 90% for RTS
baris.zh: LSI 逐步提高：> 80% 可开始跑步，≥ 90% 可重返运动（RTS）
baris.uz: LSI ortib bormoqda: yugurishni boshlash uchun > 80%, RTS uchun ≥ 90%

baris.en: **A change of ≥ 11.5 points is considered meaningful (MCID)**
**A change of ≥ 8–10 points is considered meaningful**
Improving as return to sport approaches
baris.zh: 临近重返运动时逐步改善

teks.id: **Bandingkan dengan nilai sebelumnya, bukan hanya target akhir.** Perubahan di bawah MCID atau di dalam kesalahan ukur belum tentu bermakna bagi pasien.
teks.en: **Compare with previous values, not only with the final target.** A change below the MCID or within measurement error may not be meaningful to the patient.
teks.zh: **应与既往数值比较，而不仅是与最终目标比较。**低于 MCID 或处于测量误差范围内的变化，对患者未必有意义。
teks.uz: **Faqat yakuniy maqsad bilan emas, oldingi qiymatlar bilan solishtiring.** MCID dan past yoki oʻlchov xatosi doirasidagi oʻzgarish bemor uchun ahamiyatli boʻlmasligi mumkin.

kicker.zh: 项目评估 · 核查人员

judul.zh: 进度延迟：合理还是需要审查？
judul.uz: Kechikish: asosli yoki koʻrib chiqish kerakmi?

pesan.en: Slow is acceptable; stalled is not
pesan.uz: Sekinlik mumkin, toʻxtab qolish mumkin emas

butir.id: Repair meniskus radial/root atau tindakan kartilago (timeline memang lebih panjang)
butir.en: Radial/root meniscal repair or cartilage procedure (the timeline is genuinely longer)
butir.zh: 半月板放射状/根部修复或软骨手术（时间线本就更长）
butir.uz: Menisk radial/ildiz tikish yoki togʻay muolajasi (muddat haqiqatan uzoqroq)

butir.zh: 并发症：关节纤维化、感染、DVT
再次手术、翻修或多韧带损伤
butir.uz: Qayta operatsiya, reviziya yoki koʻp boylamli jarohat

butir.id: Progres objektif tetap ada walau lebih lambat
butir.en: Objective progress continues, albeit more slowly
butir.zh: 客观进展仍然存在，只是较慢
butir.uz: Sekinroq boʻlsa ham obyektiv progress mavjud

butir.zh: 无注明日期的客观数据

butir.id: Tidak ada perbaikan bermakna pada ≥ 2 evaluasi berturut-turut*
butir.en: No meaningful improvement over ≥ 2 consecutive assessments*
butir.zh: 连续 ≥ 2 次评估无显著改善*

butir.id: Isi terapi tidak berubah atau hanya modalitas pasif
butir.en: Therapy content unchanged or passive modalities only
butir.zh: 治疗内容无变化或仅为被动理疗
butir.uz: Davolash mazmuni oʻzgarmagan yoki faqat passiv muolajalar

butir.id: Target fase tidak diperbarui; tidak ada program latihan mandiri
butir.en: Phase targets not updated; no home-exercise programme
butir.zh: 阶段目标未更新；无自主训练计划
butir.uz: Bosqich maqsadlari yangilanmagan; mustaqil mashq dasturi yoʻq

teks.id: **Matriks keputusan**
teks.en: **Decision matrix**
teks.zh: **决策矩阵**
teks.uz: **Qaror matritsasi**

judul.en: Progress in line with the gates

teks.id: → **Lanjutkan program**
teks.en: → **Continue the programme**
teks.zh: → **继续当前计划**
teks.uz: → **Dasturni davom ettiring**

judul.id: Lambat, tapi ada progres & alasan jelas
judul.en: Slow, but with progress & a clear reason
judul.zh: 较慢，但有进展且原因明确
judul.uz: Sekin, lekin progress va aniq sabab bor

teks.id: → **Lanjutkan dengan target dan batas waktu baru**
teks.en: → **Continue with new targets and a new deadline**
teks.zh: → **以新目标和新期限继续**
teks.uz: → **Yangi maqsad va muddat bilan davom ettiring**

judul.id: Tidak ada progres atau ada tanda bahaya
judul.en: No progress or red flags present
judul.zh: 无进展或出现危险信号
judul.uz: Progress yoʻq yoki xavfli belgilar bor

teks.id: → **Rujuk ke operator / tinjauan sejawat**
teks.en: → **Refer to the operating surgeon / peer review**
teks.zh: → **转诊至主刀医生/同行评议**
teks.uz: → **Operatsiya qilgan shifokorga yoʻllang / hamkasblar ekspertizasi**

judul.zh: 已通过关卡或功能进入平台期

teks.id: → **Transisi ke program latihan mandiri**
teks.en: → **Transition to a self-managed exercise programme**
teks.zh: → **过渡到自主训练计划**
teks.uz: → **Mustaqil mashq dasturiga oʻting**

teks.id: * Ambang praktis yang diusulkan, bukan dari pedoman; sesuaikan dengan kebijakan penjamin. Referensi: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022 · [25] Irrgang 2006
teks.en: * Proposed practical threshold, not from guidelines; adapt to the payer’s policy. References: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022 · [25] Irrgang 2006
teks.zh: * 为建议的实用阈值，并非出自指南；请根据承保方政策调整。参考文献：[1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022 · [25] Irrgang 2006
teks.uz: * Taklif etilgan amaliy chegara, qoʻllanmadan emas; toʻlovchi siyosatiga moslang. Manbalar: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [14] Calanna 2022 · [25] Irrgang 2006

judul.uz: Esda saqlash kerak boʻlgan olti xulosa

judul.id: Naik fase berdasarkan kriteria, bukan kalender
judul.en: Progress through phases by criteria, not by calendar
judul.zh: 依据标准而非日历晋级阶段
judul.uz: Bosqichdan bosqichga kalendar emas, mezonlar asosida oʻting

judul.id: Ekstensi penuh & aktivasi quadriceps adalah prioritas minggu-minggu awal
judul.en: Full extension & quadriceps activation are the priorities of the early weeks
judul.zh: 完全伸直与股四头肌激活是术后最初几周的重点
judul.uz: Toʻliq yozilish va kvadritseps faollashuvi — dastlabki haftalarning ustuvor vazifasi

judul.id: Jenis tindakan meniskus menentukan batas menapak, fleksi, dan brace
judul.en: The type of meniscal procedure determines weight-bearing, flexion, and brace limits
judul.zh: 半月板手术类型决定负重、屈曲和支具的限制
judul.uz: Menisk muolajasi turi tayanish, bukilish va ortez cheklovlarini belgilaydi

judul.id: Limb Symmetry Index (LSI) saja bisa menyesatkan; bandingkan dengan kapasitas pra-cedera
judul.en: The Limb Symmetry Index (LSI) alone can be misleading; compare with pre-injury capacity
judul.zh: 仅凭肢体对称指数（LSI）可能产生误导；应与伤前能力比较
judul.uz: Faqat Limb Symmetry Index (LSI) chalgʻitishi mumkin; jarohatdan oldingi imkoniyat bilan solishtiring

judul.id: Kerja kantoran bisa mulai dalam minggu; atlet kembali bertanding ≥ 9–12 bulan
judul.en: Office work can resume within weeks; athletes return to competition at ≥ 9–12 months
judul.zh: 办公室工作数周内即可恢复；运动员重返比赛需 ≥ 9–12 个月
judul.uz: Ofis ishiga bir necha haftada qaytish mumkin; sportchilar musobaqaga ≥ 9–12 oyda qaytadi

judul.id: Program yang melewati timeline dinilai dari progres objektif, bukan durasi
judul.en: Programmes exceeding the timeline are judged on objective progress, not duration
judul.zh: 超出时间线的项目应依据客观进展而非时长来评价
judul.uz: Muddatdan oshgan dastur davomiylik boʻyicha emas, obyektiv progress boʻyicha baholanadi

teks.id: Program selalu disesuaikan oleh dokter operator dan tim rehabilitasi.
teks.en: The programme is always tailored by the operating surgeon and the rehabilitation team.
teks.zh: 康复计划始终由主刀医生和康复团队个体化调整。
teks.uz: Dastur har doim operatsiya qilgan shifokor va reabilitatsiya jamoasi tomonidan moslashtiriladi.
